description: April 26 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 1, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 26 birthday falls in Taurus, in the first decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: April 26 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Twenty-six reduces to 8, and April 26 gives that material ambition to the zodiac's most practical builder of comfort. About six degrees into Taurus, under Venus's first decan, the tradition sees someone patient with money and resources, who tends to accumulate skill, property or reputation slowly and keep hold of it.

On April 26 the Sun usually sits at about 6° Taurus, in the first decan, where Venus rules the decan as well as the sign. With Venus as both ruler and sub-ruler, the first decan of Taurus is traditionally seen as the sign at its most sensuous and steady. Birthdays from about April 20 to April 30 land here. The emphasis is on comfort that has been earned: texture, taste, music and the slow pleasure of things done well. This doubled Venus tone is often linked with loyalty and a calm, grounding presence that friends lean on. It can also make change feel like an imposition rather than an invitation. Those born in this decan tend to flourish when they treat flexibility as another form of care, not a threat to it.

sections.heading: April 26 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 26th reduces as 2 + 6 = 8. Here the 2's cooperative instinct and the 6's sense of responsibility build towards the 8's practical power. Twenty-sixth-born people are often described as capable organisers who lead through care, managing a household, a business or a community with both warmth and firmness. They tend to think about security for the people they love. As a secondary number, the 26 is traditionally associated with sound judgement in material matters. Balancing control with trust in others is often part of their path.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one April 26 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on April 26: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 26 is the 116th day of the year (117th in a leap year). By May 21, 25 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Gemini.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 26, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on April 26 include Ludwig Wittgenstein (1889), Eugène Delacroix (1798) and Jet Li (1963).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 26?
faq.answer: April 26 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 26?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 26 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 26th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 26?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an April 26 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 26?
faq.answer: April 26 is also the birthday of Ludwig Wittgenstein (1889), Eugène Delacroix (1798) and Jet Li (1963). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
